nodes.label: Phantom-Flow 3-Way Transparency Stack
nodes.rationale: Combines three free open-source feeds (OpenInsider, QuiverQuant, Finnhub) to achieve a Bloomberg-style flow-of-funds transparency picture without paid institutional terminals.

nodes.label: Streamlit Reverse Proxy Guard Rationale
nodes.rationale: Setting headless=true, address=0.0.0.0, enableCORS=false, and enableXsrfProtection=false with dynamic $PORT binding prevents WebSocket 403 errors behind Render's reverse proxy.

nodes.label: Multi-Factor Confluence Synthesis
nodes.rationale: Extends pure technical price action (VWAP & EMA20) by weighting OpenInsider Form 4, QuiverQuant Congress, Finnhub 13F, News Radar, and Wyckoff phases to dynamically modulate recommendations, stops, and profit targets.

nodes.label: Wyckoff Range Engine (wyckoff.py)
nodes.rationale: Automates classic Wyckoff accumulation/distribution range detection (Creek/Ice boundaries, Phases A-E, SC/BC/AR/ST/Spring/UTAD/SOS/SOW, 0-100 quality scoring) and builds R-multiple multi-target trade setups (SL, TP1 breakeven, TP2 measured move, TP3 runner).

nodes.label: JEV + RAG Intelligent Gating System (jev_rag.py)
nodes.rationale: Solves standard RAG noise, hallucinations, and latency in trading by adding query triaging, context compression, sufficiency gating, and mathematical post-generation grounding.

nodes.label: Standard RAG Failure Modes in Trading
nodes.norm_label: standard rag failure modes in trading
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered financial RAG suffers from clickbait/stale news noise, hallucinated price targets or Form 4 dates, and high LLM latency/token cost on every ticker switch.

nodes.label: JevHallucinationAndGroundingCheck
nodes.rationale: Mathematically verifies suggested entry zones, stop-losses, and profit targets against live price, ATR, and Wyckoff Ice/Spring structural levels to enforce R:R >= 1.0 and eliminate inverted bounds.

nodes.label: JEV + RAG Streamlit HUD & Gateway Tab
nodes.norm_label: jev + rag streamlit hud & gateway tab

nodes.label: Sufficiency Gating & Graceful Refusal
nodes.rationale: Audits external catalyst and smart money evidence before altering trade bias; triggers Graceful Exit (impact_adjustment = 0.0) when evidence is weak or unconfirmed to prevent false signals.

nodes.label: OmniRoute Exclusive LLM Routing (Hermes & Bionic)
nodes.rationale: Removed all OpenRouter references, keys, caches, and fallbacks from Hermes Agent and Bionic/LM Studio so all inference routes strictly through local OmniRoute (http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1).

nodes.label: AI Agent Audit 401 Fix & Key Resolution Chain
nodes.norm_label: ai agent audit 401 fix & key resolution chain
nodes.rationale: HTTP 401 'User not found' was caused by a dead hardcoded OpenRouter fallback key and hidden sidebar key input; fixed via URL ?key -> Streamlit Secrets -> Env -> Sidebar resolution and one-click key forwarding from stock-signal-scanner.

nodes.label: Yahoo Finance Analyst Consensus Fallback
nodes.rationale: Added automatic yfinance analyst estimate fallback in TradingBot/app.py when Finnhub returns 401/403 so Finnhub Target and Wall St. Consensus cards stay populated instead of showing $N/A.

nodes.label: engine/federation.py Circular Import Fix
nodes.rationale: Fixed a circular self-import in engine/federation.py identified during the runtime and deployment code audit.

nodes.label: Calibrated Decision Engine (engine/predict.py)
nodes.rationale: Replaced synthetic random stubs with calibrated risk, impact, latency, slippage, and mode models plus synthesize_openbb_decision driven by live OpenBB microstructure, fundamentals, news sentiment, and macro stress.

nodes.label: Parallel Specialist Agents & synthesize_quant_committee Fallback
nodes.rationale: Parallelized Technical Strategist, Fundamental Analyst, and Sentiment & Insider Agent with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) and added synthesize_quant_committee to guarantee a zero-failure 4-agent quantitative report when LLM keys are missing or rate-limited.

nodes.label: Secret Redaction & Environment Variable Policy
nodes.rationale: All API keys, tokens, and credentials from original transcripts are replaced with [REDACTED]; real secrets must never be committed to the repository and should be configured via gitignored .env or Render / Streamlit Secrets environment variables.
